notes.title: Update to milestone 1 version 0.8.100
notes.content:
With the main story and main game relatively stable now, after the 0xx series of updates, I'm moving on to core gameplay improvements and combat enhancements in the 1xx series. Originally the NPC update, I've decided to push that back 1 milestone to work on more important gameplay elements to ensure the game is fun to play and provides a smooth experience to the player. With gamepad support coming as well, this series of updates should pretty drastically change how things play and get us closer to the games final vision.

[list]
[*]Dolphin Dash is now set to Left-Shift and functions as both a dash and a sprint, when held down
[*]Relevant tutorial about Dolphin Dash updated.
[*]Deleted boss projectiles when entering a dialogue to prevent damage while speaking.
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed the player to get hit by 1 attack multiple times a frame, dealing far too much damage.
[*]Hair physics for in-game model have been deactivated for now due to crashes
[*]Obsidian Skin skill has been changed to Magma Aura, and provides a significant damage boost, and damages any nearby enemies.
[*]Stamina now gradually increases smoothly
[*]All crafting recipes are now unlocked by default to encourage crafting and testing builds earlier.
[*]Ice Shield now has a higher initial cost, but allows for you to slowly move, instead of being completely immobile.
[*]The Siren Seal's puzzle now has a guide available
[*]Hazard damage for the final area's have been lowered
[*]Debug menus can now be used in Crystal Palace by locking and unlocking cursor
[*]The whirlpool effect for the Arpas boss fight is less intense for visual clarity
[*]A work in progress combat menu has been added, will be improved in further beta-build updates
[*]Stage 1 of the new world map gameplay has been added that replaces the floating cursor.
[*]Siren Song ability can now be charged in combat for a big HP regeneration effect
[*]Purify now has the combat ability of cutting Stun costs in half, making it easier to Stun-Break enemies
[*]A bug that would delete the camera in Mangled Cave level has been fixed
[*]Siren Seals no longer need to be completed perfectly, and allow for a few errors
[/list]

Many more combat and core gameplay improvements are coming.
Thanks so much for your early support, and the suggestions and feedback from the Discord!

-DevDre

After four years of development Miuratale is finally ready to enter Early Access! Start your journey as Keena, the Miura red-tail mermaid, as she enters the depths of mythology and adventure!

notes.title: Early Access for Miuratale starts on March 29th!
notes.content:
I'm super happy to announce that Miuratale is now feature complete! The main story, core features, combat system, boss fights, and cutscenes are all in a state that is acceptable for the Early Access launch this 29th!

Some things are more complete than others, cutscenes will be receiving a final draft pass, NPC's are bare bones, the combat system will need tweaks and rebalances... Some enemies are too hard, some are too easy, so-on, but in general the game is fully completable and I clocked in a completion time of 15 Hours in a no equipment, no item run!


I'm currently working on implementing fixes and improvements that I have gathered from alpha testers and the list is very long! This is my 2nd game and it is a huge jump up in challenge and scope, but one I really want to nail. I see Miuratale as the real start of my game development career and my plan is to continue to improve and expand upon it until the vision is fully realized.

My current plans, pre-release, are to implement gameplay improvements and bug-fixes, get a functioning website with the Early Access roadmap accessible to fans, get the soundtrack and SFX into the game, and to start replace the last few placeholders that are still in the game.


The plan for Early Access is to launch by the 29th, the game will go on sale for roughly 5$ USD on a major release discount, and after a few weeks will raise to roughly 10$ USD. When the Early Access is finished there will be a price increase to roughly 20$ USD, but this will include all future content, which includes the following :

2 Content packs that bring new quests, dungeons, improved designs, and challenges to the game
2 Minigame/Activity packs that bring fun new lore-expanding, optional gameplay to the world
2 Expansions that directly continue the story, with new bosses, new content, and new ways of experience the game's current content.

I'm expecting around a year of support to get the Early Access finished and to expand upon it with these updates.


The game may be complete, but there is still a lot of work to do! I do plan on taking a break once I get it out of Early Access, I need a vacation from my workspace and the constant grind... Until then, I'll be getting this thing ready!

notes.title: Delay and Update
notes.content:
[h1]Miuratale Update![/h1]

The alpha build is in progress! It's been a lot of work, and the game's evolved significantly since we started this project years ago. Right now, our script has several thousand lines of dialogue! The first prototype from 2 years ago took just an hour to complete, which led us to revamp the script and game, shifting from Metroidvania to RPG. Now, the dialogue alone for the main story takes 4 hours to go through.

We've got about 50 levels, ranging from small caves to massive, 3D cruise ships you can explore inside and out. Plus, we have 50 different enemies and 14 bosses!

All this shows how much the game has grown, but we’re done! No more expanding, just polishing and fixing bugs from here on out.

Here’s what’s coming up...

[list]
[*]First, we're planning a free demo set halfway through the game to give players a taste of combat, exploration, and optional side content!
[*]There won’t be early access. This is really important to me and won't change. We stand by our design choices, and Miuratale has been patiently and carefully crafted, tested, and built to provide the best experience possible. We want new players to get the complete, polished experience right from the start.
[*]And finally, we’ll also have a free major update post-release that will expand on the story, world map, and combat!
[/list]

I hope you understand the delay. I don’t want to release this game until it’s fully finished, and while I think it’ll be done this year, it won't be [i]finished[/i].

To wrap up, I wanted to share a work-in-progress picture of the game's Hub area! The Crystal Palace is one of several areas you can fully explore in 3D using simplified mouse controls and is home to the game's side content!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841837/5ebecb1d4ed09be83df1a3326b09e51d459832a3.jpg[/img]

Also, for those who want more updates, please follow us on IndieDB : [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/miuratale]https://www.indiedb.com/games/miuratale[/url]

Thank you for reading,

DevDre
Carrionwave

notes.title: Development blog featured over on IndieDB
notes.content:
Hello prospective mermaids!

Carrionwave's second game is a serious step up from our last, a full RPG set in a fantastical ocean world ruled by mermaids and sea creatures. With the help of our freelance designer, Nemi, we have a strong art identity, alongside our world and lore. 

We have roughly a year of work left, a lot of 3D assets to make, systems to polish, and a story to tell... It's going to be !fun!.


It's my goal to post developmental updates over on indieDB to keep a record of our progress, and focus on specific features and elements of the game.

I hope you'll consider following along while we work!

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/miuratale]https://www.indiedb.com/games/miuratale[/url]

Thank you for reading and I'll see you next time!

DevDre,
